Coast Guard Navik CGEPT 02/2026 Batch Stage-III Admit Card - Complete Details

Short Information : Join Indian Coast Guard has released the Stage-III Admit Card for the post of Navik GD & Yantrik 01/2026 & 02/2026 Batch on the official website of the Indian Coast Guard. This recruitment was released for 630 posts. Applications for the Coast Guard Navik & Yantrik 01, 02/2026 Recruitment 2025 were accepted from June 11, 2025, to June 29, 2025. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Coast Guard Navik CGEPT 02/2026 Batch Stage-III Admit Card from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 June 2025
  • Last Date : 29 June 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 June 2025
  • Correction/ Edit Form : 04-06 July 2025 (11:30 PM)
  • Exam Date : September 2025
  • Exam City Details : 04 September 2025
  • Admit Card : 17 September 2025
  • Result : 29 October 2025
  • Stage-III Admit Card : 19 June 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates (Other than SC / ST) : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST : No Fee
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
